https://shop.weverse.io/en/notices/12149.text: payment and customs service update weverse shop payment and customs service update hello from weverse global , the official merch store. starting february 3, 2026 , we will be updating parts of our payment environment to enhance our payment system in line with the latest global tax regulations and to provide a smoother customs clearance experience worldwide. please refer to the details below. [key updates] 1. accurate tax calculation based on address area-specific tax rates applied : in accordance with tax laws that vary by country and region, applicable taxes will be automatically calculated and applied at checkout based on the final shipping address or billing address you provide. price display based on shipping destination orders shipped to korea : prices will continue to be displayed as tax-inclusive amounts from the product detail page through checkout, as they are currently. orders shipped outside of korea : prices on the product detail page will be displayed as tax-exclusive amounts. the applicable taxes based on the destination country/region will be added at checkout once the shipping address is entered. please note : the initial price shown on the product detail page may vary depending on your address. this difference is due to area-specific tax display regulations. the final payment amount will be calculated based on the tax rate of the shipping destination entered at checkout. 2. introduction of prepaid duties and taxes instead of paying customs duties and taxes directly to customs authorities upon delivery, applicable taxes will now be prepaid at checkout . (not applied to certain countries/regions) by prepaying taxes at the time of purchase, the need for additional payments during customs clearance may be reduced, allowing for faster delivery. 3. addition of billing address field to ensure accurate tax calculation, a billing address field is added at checkout. for certain intangible products ( such as digital products or content ), the billing address may be required. please make sure to enter accurate address information when completing your payment. [effective date and applicable products] effective date : february 3, 2026 applicable products : products sold and shipped from korea for applicable products, the billing address field and tax details will be displayed on the checkout page. this update is part of our efforts to comply with global commerce standards, reduce customs-related inconvenience , and provide a more reliable shopping experience for our fans. we appreciate your understanding. weverse shop will strive to provide a more convenient and trusted fan experience. thank you. terms and conditions paid services terms and conditions child and youth protection policy privacy policy cookie policy cookie settings weverse company business info tel.
